በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ስቅለቱ: ስቅለት — his crucifixion, hanging (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
ተነበዩ: ተነበየ — they prophesied (3mp perfect, tä-stem, n-b-y)
ለክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — of Christ, Christ's (ለ- naming the possessor after an anticipating suffix) · ለ- marking the object, doubled by the suffix on ወያመስልዎ ('they liken Christ')
ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will') · as object after ሰብሐ ('praise God', ይሴብሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ብዙኃን: ብዙኅ — many (adjective, plural ብዙኃን, used as a noun)
እደዊየ: እድ — my hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -የ '1cs my')
ኵሎ: ኵሉ — all (accusative) · 'everything', used alone (እሰፍን ኵሎ 'I measure everything')
እሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — they indeed, they for their part (3mp pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ለርእሶሙ: ርእስ — for themselves (ለ- + ርእስ 'head, self' + -ሙ '3mp their')
ወተዓፀዉ: ዐፀወ (?) — and they … (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem); the nearest real root ዐፀወ means 'shut, enclose', 'cast lots' is a guess from ዕፃ
ተከሥተ: ከሠተ — it was opened, revealed (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ከሠተ)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
ጽምእት: ጽሙእ — dry, thirsty (adjective, fem. ጽምእት, agreeing with ምድር 'land')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ላሕየ: ላሕይ — beautiful, comely (noun or adjective, 'beauty, beautiful'; accusative of respect, 'beautiful of form') (?)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ምኑን: ምኑን — despised (passive participle of መነነ; adjective)
እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all') · 'by all' after a passive (እሴባሕ እምኵሉ መላእክት 'I am praised by all the angels')
ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ሜጠ: ሜጠ — he turned (3ms perfect, G; root m-y-ṭ)
ለጻድቅ: ጻድቅ — the righteous (ለ- 'to' marking the object + adjective/noun)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?) · 'came to be' with a noun predicate/subject (በዕፅ ኮነ መድኀኒቱ ለአዳም 'through wood came Adam's salvation'; ኮነ ቀዳሚ ስሕተቱ 'came his first error'); ኮነት 'she became' of the rod (ወኮነት ዘነፍስ 'and it became living')
ኢያስሕቱከ: አስሐተ — lest they lead you astray (ከመ ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative, s-ḥ-t + -ka '2ms')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
ለኵልነ: ኵሉ — for all of us (ለ- + ኵል- + -ነ '1cp')
በከ: በ — by you (በ- 'by, in' + -ከ '2ms you'); sense uncertain (?) · the first part of በከመ 'according as', printed as two words በከ ፡ መ (source slip)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ለጽምእየ: ጽምእ — for my thirst (ለ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ሐየውነ: ሐየወ — we live (1cp perfect used as a conditional, G, ḥ-y-w)
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
ወመጽአ: መጽአ — and he came (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
እምደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — from the sons of (እም- 'from' + plural construct 'sons of')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ህየንተ: ህየንተ — in place of, instead of (preposition, + genitive)
ሠናይት: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adjective, fem. sg. ሠናይት) · used as a noun, 'good (things)' (ውስተ ሠናይት 'into good')
ይርአይዎ: ርእየ — that they see him (3mp subjunctive, G, r-ʾ-y + -ዎ '3ms him')
ወብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — and many (ወ- + adjective, accusative, agreeing with ተኣምረ ወመንክረ)
ትንቢተ: ትንቢት — prophecy of (noun, fem., construct state)
ወሞቱ: ሞተ — and they died (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, m-w-t)
በስብሐት: ስብሐት — in glory, in praise (በ- + noun)
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (አዝማዲሆሙ ለእለ ኀልቁ 'the kinsmen of those who perished')
ተብህለ: ብህለ — it is said (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ብህለ)
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53) · ነገረ — he spoke, said (3ms perfect, G, n-g-r; ነገረ እንዘ ይብል 'he spoke, saying')
ሃይማኖተ: ሃይማኖት — faith (noun, fem.; accusative) · construct 'faith of' (ሃይማኖተ ሮም 'the faith of Rome'; ሃይማኖተ ክርስቶስ 'the faith of Christ')
መድኀኒተ: መድኀኒት — salvation, saviour (noun; accusative predicate: 'you will be a salvation', i.e. a saviour) · construct 'salvation of' (መድኀኒተ ደቂቅከ 'the salvation of your sons') · 'of the saviour' before a relative clause (መድኀኒተ ዘተፈነወ 'of the saviour who was sent') · accusative object, 'salvation' (ወሀበ እግዚኣብሔር መድኀኒተ 'God gave salvation'; ረሰየ ሎቱ መድኀኒተ 'he made salvation for him') · second accusative after ረሰየ/ረሰያ, 'a saviour' (ረሰያ ለታቦት መድኀኒተ 'He made the Ark a saviour')
ተንሥእ: ተንሥአ — arise! (2ms imperative, Gt, root n-s-ʾ)
ለምድር: ምድር — to/for the earth, or earth as object (ለ- + noun) · 'of the earth', ለ- as genitive link (ወእምስፍሓ ለምድር 'and from the breadth of the earth')
ወደገመ: ደገመ — and he repeated (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
ኀያል: ኀያል — strong, mighty (adjective; also 'a mighty one', noun)
ኢገብረ: ገብረ — he did not do (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G)
ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')
ብርሃነ: ብርሃን — light, brightness (construct 'brightness of') · accusative, object (ኢይርአይ ብርሃነ 'that he not see light')
ወያጸድቆ: አጽደቀ — and he declares him righteous, justifies him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ጸድቀ, + -ኦ 'him'; ṣ-d-q)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ይትቀነይ: ተቀንየ — he serves (3ms imperfect, Gt of ቀነየ, q-n-y; lemma the 3ms perfect)
ለጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — justice, righteousness (ለ- + noun; naming what suffix -ā pointed to) · ጸራ ለጽድቅ 'enemies to/of righteousness', ለ- 'to, of' with no suffix before it (?)
ለነፍስየ: ነፍስ — my soul (ለ- marking the object + noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my') · 'to my soul' after አሌ 'woe' (አሌላ ለነፍስየ)
ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
ወይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — and may he be exalted (ወ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem, root l-ʿ-l 'be high') · and it will be exalted, with a thing as subject (ወይትሌዐል ክብርከ 'and your glory will be exalted')
ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
ወይገብእ: ገብአ — and it will return, pass (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
